title: List of Tables styling and standalone PDF
description: Style the standalone tables_list.html and generate tables_list.pdf
success_criteria: Use the same fonts as mkdocs
Table list links are black with no text decoration
The left margin of the table list is 0.75 inches
The right margin of the table list is 0.75 inches
Table entry lines use the same font family as mkdocs body text
List of tables title uses the same font as mkdocs
List of tables title has a gray bottom border
Leader dots extend to the page number column
The standa-alone list of tables PDF is present in the output directory when this task is completed
notes: tablelist.css in e_pdfhtml_and_pdf/css/. tables_list.html is standalone (not MkDocs nav). tables_list.pdf generated by md2pdf.py.
